---
name: decision-defer-bulk-import
description: The bulk import waits for BOTH source exports and runs as a single pass - one is in hand, the other is not; decided 2026-08-07, do not start early
type: decision
source: claude-code
captured: 2026-08-07
visibility: local
domain: personal
---
**Decision (2026-08-07 evening):** the bulk import - import, distill, synthesize, reconcile -
waits until **both** source exports are in hand and then runs as **one pass**. The first
export arrived 2026-08-07 (verified). The **second has not arrived** and was expected to
take another day or two.

**Why:** the two corpora overlap heavily in subject matter. A split run means the second
pass must dedupe against items the first pass already wrote, with no shared adjudicator -
the synthesis detector is report-only. A single pass over both keeps "recency beats volume"
decidable in one place.

**How to apply:** when the second export lands, do not go straight to ingestion. Restore a
runnable health check first - importing hundreds of items into a brain with no runnable
check reproduces an earlier failure at scale.
</MEMORY>
